Class JSONSerializer

java.lang.Object
com.reactiveplayz.rml.serializer.JSONSerializer

  • Constructor Details

    • JSONSerializer

      public JSONSerializer(RMLFile rmlFile)
      Serializes a RMLFile into JSON

      Any changes made to the RMLFile will not update the JSON. Use updateJSON() to update the JSON after changes are made to the RMLFile

      Parameters:
      rmlFile - The RMLFile to serialize into JSON

      public com.google.gson.JsonObject getAsJSON()
